Disney invested **$2,466 million (~$2.5 billion)** in parks, resorts and other property in Q1 fiscal 2025 (quarter ended December 28, 2024), up from $1,299 million (~$1.3 billion) in the prior-year quarter — an increase of roughly $1.2 billion.

**Main driver of the increase:** Higher spending on **cruise ship fleet expansion at the Experiences segment**.

Segment breakdown of capital expenditures (Q1 FY25 vs. Q1 FY24):
- Entertainment: $268M vs. $309M
- Sports: $1M vs. $0
- Experiences – Domestic: $1,786M vs. $571M
- Experiences – International: $293M vs. $244M
- Total Experiences: $2,079M vs. $815M
- Corporate: $118M vs. $175M

The Experiences segment accounted for nearly all of the increase, with domestic Experiences capex more than tripling year over year.
